blind.description: A stylized dark wooden rack holding four distinct wizard staves. The wooden rack has a planked backboard, a bottom tray base, and an upper notched rail. Stored inside are four different staves: a pale gnarled staff clutching a red egg-shaped gem, a reddish-brown staff with a polished brass sphere top, a dark twisted wooden shepherd's crook, and a dark wooden staff holding a cyan crystal in a golden claw setting. Geometry is solid, clean, and continuous with no floating, melted, or missing elements.
blind.from_above: A narrow rectangular wooden silhouette showing the tops of four staves arranged in a line (a red gem held in prongs, a gold sphere, a dark curled crook, and a blue pointed gem), casting a tall shadow to the upper left.
blind.height_vs_figure: Reaches roughly chest/shoulder height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (about 4.3 to 4.5 ft tall) and is roughly 2.5 ft wide.
